classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mm_aim.desc: Stand still and crouch a moment before you fire: your shot hits harder, your aim reaches wider and an early gun strays less, each rank.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mm_load.desc: Every third kill with a gun readies you: your next reload is done at once, with a spin of the gun.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mm_called.desc: Sneak and fire: where the shot strikes counts. The head takes a heavy hit, an arm drops its weapon, and a leg limps (crippled, for a short while).
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mm_quick.desc: With your gun loaded, a foe that swings at you or a friend within 10 blocks takes your shot as the blow lands. Once each short rest.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.mm_precision.de: A shot that lands on a foe that doesn't know you're there, or on a crippled one, is always a critical.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.bench_smith.des: You can make guns, gun barrels and shot at the stations. Without it you can't, and a weaponsmith sells them to you instead.
Sneak and use a station with a gun in hand and the part's stuff in the off hand to fit one part to it, one more a gun per rank: Muffled (wool: no noise heard), Long Barrel (an iron ingot: further), Choke (a copper ingot, on a blunderbuss: its shot held tight) or Bayonet (a sword: a blow with the gun).
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.bench_trick.des: Sneak and use a station with arrows in hand to make four trick bolts from what is in the off hand: grapple (a tripwire hook: pulls you to where it sticks), oil (coal: what it soaks burns longer and harder), water (a water bottle: puts out fire and leaves foes soaked, so lightning hurts them more) or shrapnel (gunpowder: bursts on the foes round what it hits).
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.bench_kit.desc: Sneak and the class key with damaged gear in hand: a small repair, from its own repair stuff in your pack (or an iron nugget), away from any station. Every 30 seconds.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.tink_hands.desc: One more infusion kept per rank, and three more kinds, made at a station with two of the stuff in the off hand: Muffled boots (wool: foes hear your steps from half as far), a Warded chest (magma cream: you freeze and burn half as fast) and a Keen blade (flint: it slowly mends itself).
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.tink_contraptio: Sneak and use four copper nuggets, with gunpowder in your pack: a scrap bundle, built in moments. Thrown, it bursts with a flash, a net, a healing mist, water, oil or a bang, or is a dud. Rank 2, Educated Guess: a dud comes back to your hand.
Sneak and touch a trap (a tripwire, its hook, a pressure plate, a hidden pit) or a locked chest with an empty hand: it comes apart. Golems and clockwork foes take far more from your blows.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.tink_pup.desc: Sneak and use a station with an empty hand, with six iron ingots, two redstone and a clock in your pack: a little clockwork dog that follows you, bites your foes and fetches what lies about.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.tink_defender.d: Your pup grows into a guard: heavier plating, and it patches you up when you're hurt near it.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.tink_hound.desc: Your pup grows into a hunter: faster, a harder bite, and it scouts out the foes about so you see them through walls.
Watch an ability once and you have it studied, with no notebook time.
